audit_items.proof_trace: Data columns from EL bypass all cryptographic verification (KZG proofs, inclusion proofs) via NewVerifiedRODataColumn direct upgrade at L714, while blobs from EL undergo verification.ELMemPoolRequirements at L641. If JWT authentication is compromised or EL connection hijacked, attacker can inject invalid data columns that skip verification.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker compromises JWT secret (network sniffing, config file access) or hijacks EL connection (MitM on http://, DNS hijack), injects malicious data columns with invalid KZG proofs. CL accepts without cryptographic validation, propagates invalid data to peers, causing consensus divergence or data availability failures.
